# nirholas

> Open-source software by nirholas: AI agents, MCP servers, 3D, on-chain tooling and developer tools. 407 public repositories.

## Catalog

- [Full machine-readable list](https://github.com/nirholas/nirholas/blob/main/repos.json): name, description, topics, language and stars for every repo
- [Human catalog](https://github.com/nirholas/nirholas#readme): grouped by topic

## Sections

- Robinhood Chain: 22 repositories
- x402 payments and agent commerce: 84 repositories
- MCP servers for AI agents: 78 repositories
- 3D AI agents and avatars: 58 repositories
- Solana and pump.fun tooling: 20 repositories
- DeFi mechanisms and Uniswap v4 hooks: 47 repositories
- On-chain experiments and collectibles: 67 repositories
- Developer tools and everything else: 31 repositories

## Featured

- [fresh-start](https://github.com/nirholas/fresh-start): Record of the former nirholas/claude-code mirror: the DMCA, the leak timeline and the x402 correction. No Anthropic code
- [XActions](https://github.com/nirholas/XActions): X/Twitter automation toolkit: scrapers, CLI and an MCP server with approval-gated write actions, no paid API.
- [cryptocurrency.cv](https://github.com/nirholas/cryptocurrency.cv): Free crypto news API aggregating 300+ sources with REST, RSS, search, sentiment and an MCP server.
- [three.ws](https://github.com/nirholas/three.ws): Give your AI agent a 3D body: rigged GLB avatars from text or a photo, an LLM brain, a Solana wallet, a one-tag embed.
- [pump-fun-sdk](https://github.com/nirholas/pump-fun-sdk): TypeScript SDK, pump CLI and MCP server for the Pump protocol on Solana: bonding curves, AMM pools and creator fees.
- [PAI](https://github.com/nirholas/PAI): Bootable Debian 12 live USB that runs Ollama locally for a private, offline AI desktop on x86_64 and ARM64.
